node: Nuclear fuel cycle: uranium conversion, enrichment, HALEU, fabrication, and fuel security
summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the public-company universe around the nuclear fuel-cycle chokepoint, with emphasis on enrichment, HALEU, fabrication, measurement, safety, and qualified nuclear-service infrastructure rather than uranium mining alone. The highest-evidence public reference name remains Centrus Energy because of DOE-backed HALEU production and enrichment licensing. Underfollowed or second-order candidates include BWX Technologies for advanced nuclear fuel fabrication and nuclear-grade manufacturing, Mirion Technologies for radiation measurement and fuel-cycle/safeguards instrumentation, and ASP Isotopes as a speculative HALEU-enrichment technology option through Quantum Leap Energy. Claims are deliberately conservative: direct HALEU production claims are treated as facts only where supported by DOE/NRC/company sources; commercialization claims for early-stage enrichment or fuel technologies are labeled hypothesis or speculation.
